title: Scientists Found Ancient Human DNA on Cave Walls for the First Time, and Some Came From Rock No One Ever Painted
description: Long after the last visitors left, the walls of prehistoric caves kept quietly holding on to something. Scientists have just found an unexpected way to find out what.

title: First fossil evidence of marine amphibian stuns paleontologists: ‘Very unusual’
170-million-year-old fossil in northern Iran presented for scientific study
description: TEHRAN - A fossilized tree trunk estimated to be 170 million years old and discovered in Iran’s northeastern Golestan province has been presented as a valuable resource for scientific research, natural heritage conservation and the development of science tourism.

title: Fatherland Feels Both Ancient and Tragically Contemporary
description: In the new film Fatherland, Thomas Mann is a standard-bearer for a tradition of liberal humanism that, though in many ways noble, proves completely incapable of fending off the most terrible evils.
